subject.title: docs: plan native UI mobile KMP migration

question: Should OpenClaw formally adopt the proposed KMP module and hand-written Swift facade as the mobile shared-logic architecture?
rationale: The page selects a durable cross-platform build, dependency, API, and ownership model that source inspection can validate but cannot authorize.

options.title: Require experiment first
options.body: Reframe the page as an investigation plan and require minimal Android/iOS build, link, and Swift API proof before adopting the architecture.

options.title: Sponsor architecture now
options.body: Merge after named Android and Apple owners explicitly accept the compatibility and long-term maintenance costs.

options.title: Retain native stacks
options.body: Resolve duplicated business rules within existing platform implementations and decline a shared KMP layer.

recommendation.title: Require experiment first
recommendation.body: Reframe the page as an investigation plan and require minimal Android/iOS build, link, and Swift API proof before adopting the architecture.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history across both Android and Apple/shared mobile surfaces.
